title: Transfer Students and the 2026-27 UIL Academic and Robotics Participation Fee: Enrollment Shares (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees)
content:
**Enrollment share.** For a UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the participation fee under the 2026-27 UIL Academic and Robotics fee schedule of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** is charged at a share set by the type of the student's district enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year, the record Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions keeps:

| Enrollment type on that record | Enrollment share |
|---|---|
| Non-Resident Transfer | 150 percent |
| Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child) | 50 percent |
| any other enrollment type, or no enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year | 100 percent |

A share is a percentage applied to an amount: 150 percent of a hypothetical 40.00 is 60.00, 50 percent of it is 20.00, and 100 percent leaves it at 40.00.

**Basis Q&A.**

*Which record decides the share?* The enrollment record of the same student for the same school year as the participation, in status enrolled. Its enrollment type, not the family's description of the student's placement, decides the share.
